description:
Create a tenant.

Creates one of your customers, with its own SES tenant (isolated reputation). `external_id` must be unique within your account.

Requires a `full_access` API key. API: `POST /tenants` (operationId `createTenant`, Tenants).

daily_limit.description: Max recipients per day for this tenant. Omit or null for no cap.

external_id.description: Your own id for the customer. Unique per account; accepted wherever a tenant id is.

name: create_tenant
title: Create a tenant
